SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.154403, -94.311806 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF NITROGEN DIOXIDE, FROM A AC 55-5 RED ACID AND E3 HAND SANITIZER (76% ETHANOL, 10% ISOPROPYL ALCOHOL) MIXTURE. CALLER STATES THAT AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF RED ACID WAS PLACED INTO A BLUE POLY DRUM THAT CONTAINED AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF RESIDUAL HAND SANITIZER. THE MIXTURE CAUSED THE GAS TO EXPAND AND SPLIT THE SIDE OF THE DRUM WHICH RELEASED NITROGEN DIOXID GAS ONTO THE FLOOR OF THE FACILITY. CALLER STATES THE NITROGEN DIOXID GAS IS HEAVIER THAN AIR AND WAS RESTRICTED TO THE FLOOR AREA OF THE FACILITY. CALLER STATES THAT (3) PERSONNEL WERE IN THE IMMEDIATE AREA OF THE DRUM, BUT THE ENTIRE FACILITY OF ABOUT (230) EMPLOYEES WERE EVACUATED. THE 3 PERSONNEL NEAR THE DRUM WERE EVALUATED AND CLEARED BY EMS. THERE ARE NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES IN THIS INCIDENT.
